status: Design only for the first P40 management increment. No production edits, tests, browser, official program, configuration or account operation performed.

productAlignment.contract: PRODUCT §3 capability-driven shared UI and verified result/cancel/recovery; §5/§6 short Chinese conclusions with expandable reasons; active P40 retains discovery/install/enablement/scope and real effect requirements.
productAlignment.firstClosedSlice: For an already discovered, supported user/repo skill, explicitly change its exact-path user preference through an official API, then report the fresh configuration and skill state. Installation, plugin-wide state, admin/system management, other Agents and Windows remain unfinished; this is not a reduced P40 completion condition.
productAlignment.noNewGate: One confirmation for the selected setting change, no model test prerequisite, no extra approval checkbox, no blanket block of conversations, and no promise of isolation against every external writer.
productAlignment.officialNamesCorrection: Readback methods are config/read and skills/list(forceReload:true); config/list does not exist in the inspected interface.

existingSurface.entry: Reuse AgentDetails → 技能与工具 → 清单类型=技能清单, current explicit folder selection and query. No new settings destination or Agent-specific visible branch.
existingSurface.retain: Existing names, plain-text descriptions, reported origin, query time/directory, partial error count, stale results, kind switch and exact old-request status/cancel remain intact. Opening details, switching kind or selecting a folder never writes settings.
existingSurface.changeWhenImplemented: Add one text action per manageable skill and a shared inline confirmation/status section below the result list. Keep list scroll position and focus origin. Extract the management section/controller rather than growing the inventory component indefinitely.
existingSurface.readOnlyCopy: Current skillLimits and sideEffects explicitly say no enable/config writes. Keep those statements for the read-only query, and add separate operation-specific text for management; do not globally mislabel all queries as writes or retain contradictory text on the confirmation.

rowAction.availability: Driven by a separate verified management capability and an exact fresh target, not Agent name or the boolean reportedEnabled. First route supports non-plugin user/repo origins only; other origins stay visible with a short specific reason when management is unavailable.
rowAction.target: Use an opaque backend RAM target tied to exact Agent/program, cwd, original skill path and config version; public index/name is not authority. Same-name rows need a safe display-only location distinction. No silent first-match selection.
rowAction.staleOrPartial: Stale rows cannot write. Partial list does not mean absent skills are disabled; a displayed exact target may proceed if its relevant configuration is independently verified, otherwise show the targeted reason.
rowAction.noOptimisticSwitch: Keep the prior badge until fresh readback. A click only opens preparation/confirmation; the row never immediately flips.

interactionSequence.behavior: Capture exact row/owner and requested enabled value. Explicitly read the official user-layer configuration and fresh target if needed. Keep old list visible; show 正在核对这项技能…. Cancel here retires the unsubmitted confirmation and returns focus to its row.

content: 技能名称 + 可辨认来源
保存到：此 Agent 的用户设置
此设置也会影响在其他文件夹中发现的同一项技能；不删除技能文件。
interactionSequence.details: Selected query directory/time, exact scope and precedence limitations, official program may use existing login/environment/cache. Current conversation adoption is not proven. No raw protocol, secret, arbitrary description link or code execution.
buttons: 确认启用 / 确认停用
interactionSequence.guard: Confirmation is a button, not implicit form submission or autofocus default. Double click/repeated Enter dispatches once. Agent, program, cwd, target or config version change retires the permission before dispatch.

interactionSequence.behavior: Use the selected exact official method and versioned user-layer change defined in the research. Preserve all non-target rules. Show 正在保存设置… then 正在核对保存结果…. A write acknowledgement alone does not flip the badge. Read config/read and skills/list with original cwd and forceReload:true.

Publish only to the same management owner/target; refresh the appropriate skills result and time only from matching fresh data. Keep MCP results untouched. A changed list order cannot select another same-name skill.

Before dispatch, withdraw confirmation with no write. After possible dispatch, close remains usable but does not mean cancelled/rolled back; operation tracking stays attached to the original Agent/kind/cwd. Reopen shows that operation with its explicit check/cancel actions; another kind must not rename it or auto-retry.

outcomes.copy: 已保存；技能报告：已启用。 / 已保存；技能报告：未启用。
outcomes.evidence: Official write accepted; fresh user-layer read shows the intended selected-rule change; fresh exact skill report matches desired enabled. Preserve unchanged-rule evidence at the controlled verification layer.
outcomes.actions: Return to list; an inverse change requires its own fresh action and confirmation.
outcomes.limit: Current conversation has not thereby been shown to load/use the change.

outcomes.copy: 设置已保存，但此次技能报告仍为未启用。
outcomes.evidence: Fresh config confirms the preference, while fresh skill report differs. If the official response proves an overriding layer, explain it in details; otherwise say the cause is unconfirmed rather than inventing an override.
outcomes.actions: 重新检查结果；查看原因. No automatic retry at a higher layer or use of the broad name selector.

outcomes.copy: 未保存。设置已变化，请重新核对。 / 未保存。这项设置不能在此修改。
outcomes.evidence: Only precise pre-write rejection such as version conflict/readonly, not arbitrary process exit or timeout.
outcomes.actions: 重新核对 returns to a fresh confirmation; never resubmits the old approval.

outcomes.copy: 设置已提交，结果尚未核实。
outcomes.evidence: Write response was obtained, but config or skills readback is missing/partial/target absent; a returned effectiveEnabled echo is not sufficient.
outcomes.actions: 重新检查结果; keep previous report visibly stale and do not change the requested value automatically.

outcomes.copy: 结果未知。请检查结果后再修改。
outcomes.evidence: Lost response, timeout, cancellation or transport failure after possible write. Same operation can later resolve only through exact completion plus fresh official readback; a read matching desired state without write acknowledgement is an observed current state, not proof this request caused it.
outcomes.actions: 检查本次操作状态 / 重新检查结果 as actually available. No blind re-write, auto rollback or success from a fresh desired value alone.

outcomes.copy: 已请求取消，尚未确认操作已结束。
outcomes.evidence: Cancel receipt is a request, not no-write evidence. Before-dispatch cancellation can be 未提交 only when backend proves it; after-dispatch cancellation may still need result readback.
outcomes.actions: Keep exact operation controls. Do not label a saved setting 已取消 or assume the read-only controller null-cancel release rules prove mutation absence.

outcomes.copy: 所选技能或设置已变化，请重新核对。 / 此项技能暂不能在此修改。
outcomes.evidence: Exact owner/ticket/target drift or missing reviewed official management route.
outcomes.actions: Preserve list and details, withdraw stale confirmation, allow explicit fresh query. Do not run official writes from an unreviewed fallback.

ownershipAndRecovery.exactIdentity: Keep read-query and write-operation identities separate. Controls always refer to the original operation; Agent/cwd/kind A→B→A never revives an old confirmation.
ownershipAndRecovery.unresolvedScope: Serialize only conflicting Farfold management work and protect the actual shared Agent/config scope. Keep independent UI navigation and existing drafts/history available; do not add a new global send prohibition merely because the panel is open.
ownershipAndRecovery.reopenAndRestart: Memory-only tracking survives panel close. After application restart require a fresh official read; do not claim old operation success or replay it. No persistent configuration mirror or operation ledger.
ownershipAndRecovery.officialRoute: Use only the official route proven by the research counterexamples; no fallback to dedicated toggle or direct private-file edits. No external all-process CAS claim.
ownershipAndRecovery.currentConversation: Say 当前对话是否采用此设置尚未核实 in details. Do not stop/reconnect a conversation or send a model request to demonstrate success without separate task authorization.

accessibilityAndFit: Existing dialog + inline review, no nested modal. Cancel restores focus only to its still-current connected row.
Tab/Shift+Tab reaches actions; one Enter must not both open and confirm. No confirmation autofocus or implicit form submission.
Existing CSS tokens/wrapping; narrow width and long text retain scope/cancel/status access without whole-window overflow.
Short status/alert and collapsed reasons; descriptions remain plain text, never links, HTML or composer content.

minimalAcceptance.proof: Actual shared component/parent + real controller/strict parser, controlled IPC: duplicate names and reordered fresh list, one confirmation, one correct target write, no write on type/folder choice, no prompt/draft/config side effects from ordinary query.

Use the existing planned owned official fixtures for AoT/inline preservation, duplicate path/name rules and scope. Verify config/read plus skills/list; retain real failures and do not substitute direct file edits.

Strict version conflict/readonly produces not-saved; accepted write plus conflicting fresh report produces persisted-but-not-effective. A reason is displayed as other-config override only when official evidence supports it.

Response lost after possible write, cancel ack, closed/reopened view, kind switch and A→B→A: no automatic resend or rollback, exact old operation can be checked, late response cannot flip new row. A write-acknowledged/readback-failed path differs from no acknowledgement.

WebKit and Chromium using real production components/controller after source freeze: Tab/Shift+Tab, one Enter does not cross both steps, cancel focus, narrow width with long row text, MCP read-only path retained. No separate design-only prototype counts as implemented.

Use ordinary candidate/install/data-retention workflow and authorized native setting change/reverse. Configuration evidence is not real skill execution. Real model adoption remains separately untested, without adding a new compulsory model smoke gate.

proposedCodeSeams: AgentExtensionInventoryResult: optional capability/target-driven row action while retaining current report metadata
Shared inline SkillSettingReview and separate memory-only setting-operation controller/types/strings; reuse AgentDetails dialog and existing view ownership
acp_client official config-read/write/skills-read adapter with opaque target/version authority and exact terminal/unknown receipts; no direct user configuration edits
deferredNotExcluded: Install/discover additional skills and move/copy scope
System/admin/plugin-wide changes and arbitrary MCP management
Automatic session restart/reload, auth flow or model request
Any claim that returned enabled preference proves a concrete tool or skill ran
requiredOfficialProof: Reuse the concrete official-interface counterexamples in next-management-surfaces.json; no additional unrelated experiments or new product acceptance gate.
